title: AgentAccessList
description: Result of the agentAccess.list JSON-RPC method: every answer a person has given to the 'may this agent use nocx's tools' question, so they can read back what they decided and unmake it (nocx-6jbad). The store was write-only from the product's side — a denial is never silently retried, deliberately, and the only way to reconsider one was editing agent-approvals.json by hand. Only answers under the tool-endpoint scope are listed, because that is the only question this document holds answers to.

answers.description: The answers, ordered by executable path then digest then workspace. The order is the backend's and it is stable: a list that reshuffles between reads is one a person cannot use to choose what to forget.

executable.description: The agent's absolute path, as it was when the answer was given.

digest.description: SHA-256 of that file's bytes. The answer is keyed by it, so a replaced program is a different row and is asked about again.

workspace.description: The workspace the answer covers, by name — not the durable scope key it is part of, whose grammar has one owner in the backend.

answer.description: What the person answered. The store's own two words; the surface is what turns them into a sentence.
